channel.title: Aidana's exercise book
channel.description: school, my family, Kyzyl-Adyr and some dreams

item.title: Last page
item.description: I don't write here any more, sorry, there is no time with lectures and the computer at my aunt's is always taken by my cousin. I will keep this blog as a souvenir. If you are a girl in 8th class in Kyzyl-Adyr reading this: study, bring two pens, and don't believe the boys about the tulips. Bye! ♥…

item.title: First session
item.description: The first session! Constitutional law, Roman law (it's very old but very sensible), history of the state. I got 5, 5, 4. The lecturer of Roman law told us that the Romans invented the contract, I said "and the third person who punishes", and he looked at me. Then he gave me a 5. Home for the…

item.title: A student
item.description: I'm now a student. In the first lecture there were 140 of us, in the big hall, with the old wooden benches. The lecturer said: "Look to your left, look to your right. By Christmas one of you will not be here." Everybody looked very hard at each other. I think he says it every year. My aunt's flat…

item.title: Packing
item.description: Tomorrow I go to Talas. Everything is in two bags and a sack of jam. Grandmother has put in her old scarf "for the cold of the city". Mama keeps remembering things: "scissors! the thermos! a spoon!". She gave me a spoon from her own set. Nurbek will take me on the bus (no bicycle). Emil is…

item.title: TSU, law faculty
item.description: I GOT IN. Law faculty of Talas State University, budget place. My uncle drove us to Talas to see the list on the wall and my name was the fourth from the top. So this exercise book is almost finished. In Talas I will live with my aunt near the Bazar-i Kalan. Mama is already packing jam for me as…

item.title: THE TEST IS OVER
item.description: I wrote it!!! History, Iradi, maths, law as the extra. I brought TWO pens (thanks to Saltanat eje's advice and to Bekzhan from the internet whose pen died in 2005). Now we wait for the results in July. I will go to the mosque with grandmother on Friday just in case.

item.title: Two weeks
item.description: Two weeks to the test. I count: maths (hopeless but improving), history (fine), Iradi (a few more essays), law (for the extra points). Mama gave me the key to the room where nobody goes, with the good desk. Grandmother makes me tea every hour, so I go to the toilet every hour. This is the system.…

item.title: Zarina is 17
item.description: We made a surprise for Zarina in the school yard: the whole class with a cake and a song, the song was out of tune. Zarina laughed so much that she had to sit on the steps. She said it was the first time since the February of two years ago that she was surprised by something that was good. She…

item.title: Daniyar again
item.description: The tulips again. This year Daniyar gave me three, one for me, one for Zarina and one for "my mother", he said, so I should give it to her. I asked: does your mother know? He went red like the sign on the bazaar. Mama accepted the tulip. She said Daniyar has a good heart and a very bad…

item.title: By the lamp
item.description: No light for most of the week. We do the homework by the lamp, Emil and I at one table, grandmother with her beads. Mama cooks on the little stove in the kitchen. The school has the cold lessons from nine to twelve. My uncle's office had light for two hours today, so I am writing this fast. In the…
